name: CONTROL POWER BOX
text:
Are you looking to buy a complete power box panel, find one here.

Complete control power box utilizes the installed system and offers remote overview over them.

Besides overview, this item also provides control over the sauna system and environment. It includes control over heaters, lights, audio/stereo system, ionizer, chromotherapy and the rest.

This device takes into account functionality of a cut-out enclosure, transformer and power supply.

It is simple to operate and offers a better sauna experience, besides being affordable and reliable.

Contact us if you’re not sure what to use or what needs replacement, or look through the available complete power boxes.
text_short: Complete control power box controls and powers up all infrared sauna electronics: heaters, lights, stereo system, ionizer, chromotherapy units, etc. This device combines the functions of cut-out enclosure, transformer and power supplying device. It is simple, easy to operate, as well as affordable and reliable control unit.
